UnitStatement: The desktop app bootstraps by mounting the App component into the #root element via ReactDOM.createRoot wrapped in React.StrictMode.

The frontend hash seam is the wasm build of the Rust engine's canonical_json / sha256_hex; the wasm lane of the canonical-hash parity corpus is asserted here against the same case files the native engine uses.
The wasm hash-parity corpus is loaded from fixtures/canonical_hash/cases.json, the shared case file blessed by the native Rust engine.
The canonical-hash parity corpus enforces a coverage floor of at least 12 cases.

Each parity case must have non-TBD expectations (blessed via CANONICAL_HASH_BLESS=1 cargo test) and the wasm engine's canonicalJsonString and canonicalSha256Hex must match the native expected_canonical and expected_sha256.
On malformed JSON the wasm engine throws the named diagnostic WASM-ENGINE-INPUT-JSON-INVALID instead of hashing it.

Engine canonicalization makes JSON key order irrelevant while content remains significant: reordered-key objects canonicalize identically (e.g. to '{"a":"x","b":[1,2,{"c":3,"d":4}]}'), and null/string scalars canonicalize to 'null'/'"text"'.
computeModelHash is stable under key reordering and sensitive to value change, yielding value sha256:<64-hex>, canonicalization rfc8785_jcs, and hash_status computed_local_preview.
computeModelHash equals the engine hash of the same payload (sha256:<direct hex>), proving there is no second hash implementation.

computePackageHash is deterministic and content-sensitive, exposes payload_excludes (default validation_report_package_hash_fields), and the carrier-exclusion label variant yields the same hash value.
canonicalJsonString drops undefined-valued keys before hashing, matching JSON.stringify semantics.

Frontend hashing routes through the wasm build of the Rust engine's canonical_json / sha256_hex via the loadWasmEngine seam; the prior TypeScript canonicalization is deleted with no fallback (absent wasm fails loudly with WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT).
asJsonText serializes a value via JSON.stringify, coercing undefined to null, so undefined-valued keys are dropped before hashing.
canonicalJsonString awaits the wasm engine and returns engine.canonicalJsonString of the value's JSON text.
canonicalSha256Hex awaits the wasm engine and returns engine.canonicalSha256Hex of the value's JSON text.

computeModelHash returns ModelHashEvidence with algorithm sha256, canonicalization rfc8785_jcs, payload_scope model_payload, payload_ref of the project id, value sha256:<hex>, and hash_status computed_local_preview.

computeProjectEnvelopeHash covers the persisted payload only, excluding the volatile storage summary and the envelope-hash carrier field (payload_excludes storage_summary_and_envelope_hash_carrier_fields) so the hash can be recomputed from a restored envelope.
computePackageHash returns PackageHashEvidence with payload_scope package_review_payload and a configurable payload_excludes defaulting to validation_report_package_hash_fields.

In browser preview, validateLibraryImport reports an explicit unavailable_browser_preview route carrying LIBRARY-IMPORT-BACKEND-DESKTOP-ONLY instead of synthesizing a validator, and does not call invoke.

In desktop mode validateLibraryImport routes through the Tauri command validate_library_import with camelCase args {payload, libraryKind, intendedVisibility} and returns the tauri_backend validation envelope.
An unsupported library_kind rejection from the backend command propagates unchanged to the caller.
partitionLibraryImportFindings splits findings along the PRD §13.5 blocking-vs-advisory axis: blocking/quarantine into blocking, review_required into advisory.
In browser preview saveLocalLibrary reports the unavailable route without calling invoke.
In desktop mode saveLocalLibrary routes through save_local_library with {projectId, libraryKind, document} and surfaces the stored flag and library_id.
A refused (not-stored) save result passes through unchanged with stored false, null timestamps, and blocking findings.
open/list/delete local-library calls route through their Tauri commands (open_local_library, list_local_libraries, delete_local_library) with camelCase args.
indexLibraryRecordsSlots indexes material records by material_id and allowable slots by allowable_id.
indexLibraryRecordsSlots gathers section slot ids across dimensions and properties in scan order.
indexLibraryRecordsSlots indexes component records by component_id and field slots by field_id.
indexLibraryRecordsSlots skips records/slots without a string id, de-duplicates slot ids, and tolerates non-array and empty shapes.
classifyLibraryReference returns resolves when both record and slot are present, record_missing when no record matches, and slot_missing when the record exists but the slot does not.

Library-import validation of an already-parsed material/section/component payload routes through the desktop Tauri command validate_library_import backed by the runtime library-import provenance crate; browser preview reports an unavailable route rather than a TypeScript fallback validator.

Imported private libraries are never transmitted or committed (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD §13.5/§17.3), and every status is a software finding only, never a legal, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance determination.

LIBRARY_IMPORT_BACKEND_DIAGNOSTIC states library-import provenance validation runs through the desktop command validate_library_import backed by core/library_import and that browser preview does not synthesize a fallback validator.
LibraryKind is one of material, section, or component.
IntendedVisibility is one of public or private.
LibraryImportFinding carries code, severity (blocking/quarantine/review_required), path, message, and remediation, where severity is the PRD §13.5 blocking-vs-advisory axis.
LibraryImportOutcome is one of QUARANTINE, REJECTED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY, or ACCEPTED_PUBLIC.
LibraryImportValidation envelope carries document_kind, outcome, library_kind, intended_visibility, accepted, has_blocking_findings, findings, diagnostics, and professional_boundary_notice.
isTauriRuntime detects the desktop runtime by checking window for __TAURI_INTERNALS__.
validateLibraryImport returns the unavailable route when not in the Tauri runtime; otherwise it invokes validate_library_import and returns a tauri_backend route.

partitionLibraryImportFindings partitions findings once at the seam: blocking/quarantine become blocking (cannot be accepted as-is) and review_required becomes advisory (human review before acceptance).

Imported private libraries persist in the local SQLite store only via the desktop backend; the store is private-by-default and never transmitted or committed, and save only persists an accepted import (blocked/quarantined returns stored:false with findings).
saveLocalLibrary invokes save_local_library with {projectId, libraryKind, document} and returns a tauri_backend save route, else the unavailable route in browser preview.
openLocalLibrary invokes open_local_library with {projectId, libraryKind, libraryId} returning the envelope or null.
listLocalLibraries invokes list_local_libraries with {projectId} returning the index entries.
deleteLocalLibrary invokes delete_local_library with {projectId, libraryKind, libraryId} returning the delete receipt.

TEMPLATE_PROVENANCE defines the invented private-draft provenance: source_name 'Invented local draft', redistribution_status private_only, review_status accepted, and a non-engineering contributor certification not for project reliance.

buildInventedLibraryImportTemplate produces a clean private-classified starting library document (schema_version 0.1.0, privacy_class private_user_data, template provenance, empty records) that validates to PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY for the user to edit.

LIBRARY_RECORD_SLOT_SHAPE per-kind dispatch must mirror the desktop resolver (extract_library_slot_value / find_library_slot_value): which member holds the records, which field is the record id, and which (slot_array, slot_id_field) pairs hold the value slots, scanned in order.
LibraryReferenceResolution is one of resolves, record_missing, slot_missing, or library_missing, where library_missing is decided by the panel (store list / null open) not by these helpers.

indexLibraryRecordsSlots is a pure function extracting record ids and per-record de-duplicated first-seen-order value-slot ids from a stored library document for a kind, mirroring the desktop resolver and never inventing missing-id or non-object entries.
classifyLibraryReference purely classifies an authored (recordId, slotId) against indexed records as record_missing, slot_missing, or resolves; library presence is decided upstream.

The cross-engine operation contract corpus runner reads the same case files as the Rust runner (contract_corpus.rs) from fixtures/model_operations/contract_corpus/ and executes each through the browser-mode adapter lane and the wasm engine directly.

Cross-engine comparison rules: exact equality on semantic fields; diagnostics compared order-insensitively as code/severity/blocking/affected_refs; engine-identity fields excluded only via the documented allowlist (application_route, diagnostics id/source/message/remediation).

Since H5 the engine canonicalization is RFC 8785 (JCS), so backend_model_hash and applied_model_backend_hash values are full byte-equality comparisons in every lane (JS transport 200.0->200 no longer shifts canonical bytes).

Applied model documents are compared both by parsed-JSON deep equality and by the engine's own canonical hash through the wasm exports; the retired ECMA harness renderer twins are superseded because engine rendering is transport-invariant.
All corpus data is invented (PUBLIC_DOMAIN_OR_ORIGINAL) with no protected standards content and no compliance/certification/approval claims.

REQUIRED_ACCEPTED_KINDS enumerates the operation kinds the corpus must cover with an accepted apply (set_field, update_load, create/delete node, connect/delete pipe_run, create section/material/support/load_case/primitive_load/combination/combination_term, and their deletes).

REQUIRED_BLOCK_CODES enumerates the blocking diagnostic codes the corpus must produce (e.g. OP-TARGET-ALREADY-EXISTS, OP-TARGET-NOT-FOUND, OP-UNIT-MISMATCH-CONVERSION-UNAVAILABLE, OP-STALE-BEFORE-VALUE, OP-NODE-DELETE-REFERENCED, OP-PIPE-DELETE-REFERENCED).
loadCases reads, filters to .json files, sorts, and parses every contract-corpus case file, asserting at least one exists.

semanticOutcome projects an engine OperationOutcome onto the cross-engine semantic comparison surface (mirrored exactly by semantic_outcome in the Rust runner), sorting diagnostics by a stable code/refs/severity key.

In the compared model_basis, backend_canonicalization label has been compared since TP-H1-HASHUNIFY-001 and backend_model_hash value joined the compared surface at H5 once RFC 8785 rendering made input-text hashes transport-invariant.

corpusCanonicalHash returns sha256:<engine canonicalSha256Hex of JSON.stringify(value)>, a single transport-invariant formula replacing the retired TS ECMA harness renderer for blessed-value comparison in every lane.
isDynamicPrimitiveMagnitudePath matches field paths of form primitive_loads.<n>.magnitude.value.
isDynamicTermFactorPath matches field paths of form terms.<n>.factor.

The corpus coverage test asserts every required accepted operation kind, every required blocking code, and both accepted and blocked instances of the dynamic field paths primitive_loads.N.magnitude.value and terms.N.factor are present.

Each adapter-lane case applies or validates the intent through operationService, asserts the input model is never mutated, asserts semanticOutcome equals the blessed outcome, and checks applied_model deep-equality plus byte-equal canonical hash (H5 full byte-equality).

The wasm engine lane runs the same 44 case files through the wasm32 build loaded exactly as browser mode loads it, proving native↔wasm parity; an absent wasm artifact fails loudly with WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT and npm run build:wasm, never skipping silently.
The wasm engine reports the honest local_wasm_engine application route.

On malformed input the wasm engine returns the structured input-error envelope (document_kind openpipestress.desktop.wasm_engine_input_error, code WASM-ENGINE-INPUT-JSON-INVALID, severity blocking) instead of trapping.

The thin-adapter tests cover routing, wasm input-error envelope handling, and engine-status reporting only; operation semantics live in core/model_operations/operation_applier and are proven by the cross-engine contract corpus.
acceptedApplyCase selects a corpus case in apply mode whose expected validation.application_status is applied_to_session_model.

In browser mode applyModelOperation routes through the wasm engine with route local_wasm_engine, sets validation.application_status applied_to_session_model, returns the expected applied_model, and never mutates the input model.
In browser mode validateModelOperation routes through the wasm engine, mode validate_only, with no applied model.
When a Tauri backend is present, apply/validate route verbatim to apply_model_operation and validate_model_operation with {model, intent, claimedModelHash}.
The adapter surfaces the wasm input-error envelope as an explicit thrown error (never a silent outcome) and passes other document kinds through.
Browser-mode operation engine status reports local_wasm_engine loading initially then ready after warmup.
With a Tauri backend present, the operation engine status reports route tauri_backend_apply as immediately ready.

operationService is a thin routing adapter for the editor-operation seam (DEC-020/ADR-0001): one engine, core/model_operations/operation_applier, answering as native via Tauri commands or the same crate as a wasm32 module; it contains routing and honest engine-status reporting only, never validation/diff/apply semantics.
outcomeFromWasmEngineJson parses a wasm-engine JSON return and, if it is the input-error envelope, throws an explicit error (the operation did not run); otherwise it returns the OperationOutcome.
runWasmOperation loads the wasm engine and runs applyOperationJson or validateOperationJson with stringified model, intent, and modelHash, returning the parsed outcome.
validateModelOperation invokes the validate_model_operation Tauri command when available, else runs the wasm engine in validate_only mode.
applyModelOperation invokes the apply_model_operation Tauri command when available, else runs the wasm engine in apply mode.
OperationEngineStatus reports which route answers operations and whether it is ready: tauri_backend_apply ready, local_wasm_engine loading/ready, or local_wasm_engine unavailable with a detail.
initialOperationEngineStatus reports tauri_backend_apply ready when a backend is present, otherwise local_wasm_engine loading.
warmupOperationEngine returns local_wasm_engine ready after loading the wasm engine, or unavailable with the error detail if loading fails (no fallback engine).
runPreviewMechanics returns the bundled solved fixture (project:invented-loop-01, MECHANICS_SOLVED, non-empty results) when no model payload is supplied.
runPreviewMechanics keeps the bundled solved fixture for the unchanged bundled model.

For an edited model in browser mode, runPreviewMechanics blocks fixture reuse: status MODEL_INCOMPLETE, empty results, and one blocking diagnostic BROWSER_SOLVE_BACKEND_REQUIRED_FOR_EDITED_MODEL, without mutating the original model.
appliedRuleCheckStatus uses a recognized rule-check aggregate over the solve rule_check (e.g. USER_RULE_FAILED, USER_RULE_CHECKED supersede RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE).
appliedRuleCheckStatus falls back to the solve rule_check for an absent, empty, or unrecognized aggregate, never coercing a non-rule-check status into a pass.
buildAnalysisRunPreview defaults analysis_status to the solve envelope rule_check when no aggregate is supplied.
A recognized rule-check aggregate drives analysis_status and the analysis_run_record hash while leaving the raw solve result_envelope hash byte-stable (the raw solve envelope is never mutated).
An unrecognized rule-check aggregate is ignored, reproducing the no-aggregate envelope exactly with no false pass.
invokeOrFixture invokes a Tauri command when the runtime is present and falls back to a bundled fixture in browser mode or on invoke failure.
loadPreviewModel returns the invented preview model fixture (or the Tauri load_preview_model command).
runPreviewMechanics invokes run_preview_mechanics with the model or falls back to the browser preview mechanics path.
SolveJobStartReceipt is either a backend_job (job_id, backend_cancellation_token, state, cancellation_scope) or browser_fixture_no_backend_job.
BackendSolveJobStatus carries job_id, state (queued/running/completed/cancelled/failed), cancellation_requested/status/scope, result, and error_message.
startPreviewMechanicsJob returns browser_fixture_no_backend_job in browser mode, else starts the backend job via start_preview_mechanics_job (falling back on failure).
pollPreviewMechanicsJob invokes poll_preview_mechanics_job with {jobId}.
cancelPreviewMechanicsJob invokes cancel_preview_mechanics_job with {jobId, cancellationToken}.
RULE_CHECK_RUN_STATUSES is the frozen set of GUI rule-check run statuses (RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED); anything outside it is not silently coerced.

appliedRuleCheckStatus returns a recognized rule-check aggregate (the worst-of over the checks run against this solve) over the solve envelope rule_check, else falls back to the solve rule_check, never a false pass.

buildAnalysisRunPreview builds the app-held analysis-run envelope (DEL-14-02) for a solved result; a supplied rule-check aggregate composes into analysis_status and the analysis_run_record hash, while the embedded result_envelope hash still binds the unmutated raw solve.

buildPreviewComparison builds a single-run load-basis comparison (DEL-14-04) by matching left load-case result rows to right combination rows via stable result ids and source_result_refs, computing raw and absolute deltas classified as not_tolerance_checked.
Comparison deltas are classified not_tolerance_checked with classification_basis governed_tolerance_profile_TBD_no_default_engineering_threshold (no default engineering threshold applied).
loadBasisRefsFor collects de-duplicated load-basis ObjectRefs (Combination or LoadCase) from a result's rows.
comparisonDiagnostics emits info COMPARISON_REFERENCE_ROWS_UNMATCHED and warning COMPARISON_TARGET_ROWS_UNMATCHED diagnostics for unmatched left/right rows, capped at 12 affected refs.
resultFamily classifies a result into displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, ratio, or TBD by inspecting its kind and id.
canonicalJson serializes a value with recursively sorted object keys (sortJson) for stable hashing.
sha256 hashes a payload via crypto.subtle when available, otherwise returns an explicit sha256-unavailable-<hex> marker rather than a real hash.

buildProposalFromMechanics generates a review-only agent proposal from the current preview mechanics context (selecting a force result or primary diagnostic as the target) whose narrative does not mutate accepted model state.

evaluateModelDocumentLocal evaluates a current document as status current with the in-document version authority, framework application_service_separate_db_and_product_schema, and no applied migrations.
A 0.1.0 document migrates in memory through the mirrored DEC-033 no-op chain entry model-doc-0.1.0-to-0.2.0-additive-combination-shape-noop to the supported version.

createLocalProject accepts a 0.1.0 document with migrated evidence while keeping stored snapshot bytes unchanged (no migration ledger in browser preview), and openLocalProject preserves the migrated status.
evaluateModelDocumentLocal refuses newer-than-supported (no down-migration), invalid non-semver (unsupported_schema), and older-with-no-path (unsupported_schema) versions without coercion.
create/save/open round-trips at the supported version yield status current, an empty migration ledger, and unit round-trip status unit_metadata_preserved_in_local_project_envelope.

buildBlankLocalModelDocument builds a blank authoring document at the supported version with empty entity arrays, MODEL_INCOMPLETE/RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE status, a not_committed_to_repository private-data policy, and a blocking BLANK_PROJECT_AUTHORING_TARGET diagnostic.
createLocalProject and saveLocalProject refuse to persist documents with refused schema versions (newer_than_supported, unsupported_schema).

DEC-033 (2026-06-12): SUPPORTED_MODEL_SCHEMA_VERSION is 0.2.0, adding the optional combination shape fields from TP-APP-R2-COMBEXPR-001; the browser preview mirrors apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/model_document_migration.rs.

MODEL_DOCUMENT_MIGRATIONS_LOCAL is the browser-preview mirror of the backend transform chain; the 0.1.0->0.2.0 step is a documented no-op (the 0.2.0 shape only adds optional combination members) that stamps the version.
parseSemver parses a strict major.minor.patch string into a numeric tuple or null.
evaluateModelDocumentLocal returns the migration status from migrateModelDocumentLocal (browser-preview mirror of the backend DEC-019 evaluation).

migrateModelDocumentLocal classifies a model document as current, migrated (walking the mirrored transform chain in memory), newer_than_supported, or unsupported_schema, refusing invalid/newer documents without coercion.

Older-than-supported documents walk the mirrored transform chain in memory, accumulating applied_migration_ids and stamping each step's target version until reaching the supported version, with stored bytes unchanged until save.
requireEditableModelDocument throws if a document's migration status is not current or migrated, surfacing status, source/target schema versions, and detail.
localOnlyCapability describes the browser memory preview storage capability: bundled, no fts5, no network/daemon/telemetry, browser-session memory fallback path, and no SQLite migration ledger.

The envelope builder mirrors DEC-019/DEC-033: older documents migrate in memory and newer/unsupported are refused, but the browser preview has no migration ledger so it stores the document bytes as given and keeps the migration as in-memory evidence (no silent destructive rewrite).
cloneEnvelope deep-clones a LocalProjectEnvelope (summary, model, intents, proposal, review target, mechanics/analysis/hashes, migration status, migration ledger).

unitRoundTripSummary collects unit metadata refs across project units, materials, sections, pipe segments, and load-case primitive loads, reporting unit_metadata_preserved when all present or unit_metadata_missing_review_required otherwise, with a sorted signature.
collectQuantityUnit records a quantity's unit ref when present, or marks it missing when the value has a quantity value but no unit.
getLocalStorageCapability returns localOnlyCapability in browser mode, else invokes get_local_storage_capability.

buildBlankLocalModelDocument builds a timestamped blank local model document at the supported schema version with explicit units, empty entity arrays, MODEL_INCOMPLETE status, and a blocking authoring-target diagnostic, inserting no fixture entities or engineering defaults.
createLocalProject stores a browser-preview snapshot via envelope in browser mode (recording timestamps), else invokes create_local_project with the model and persisted artifacts.
openLocalProject returns a cloned browser-preview snapshot (re-validating editability, optionally filtered by project id) in browser mode, else invokes open_local_project.
listLocalProjects returns the single browser-preview snapshot index entry in browser mode, else invokes list_local_projects.
saveLocalProject overwrites the browser-preview snapshot in browser mode, else invokes save_local_project with a request carrying the model and persisted artifacts.

DEC-021 (A7): the hash-bound report renderer is a Rust crate reached through the desktop Tauri command seam; the browser preview exposes no rendering seam and there is no fallback renderer (browser mode reports an explicit unavailable route).
RenderedReportOutcome carries html, sha256_hex, export_blocked, blocking_reasons, report/section validation diagnostics, pre/post-render findings, and derived_print_html.

renderCalculationReport returns an unavailable_browser_preview route with REPORT-RENDERER-DESKTOP-ONLY when not in the Tauri runtime, else invokes render_calculation_report and returns the tauri_renderer outcome.
